verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents an official CLI on its own docs page that lets users create inboxes, send messages and manage threads without writing code. The CLI ships as a single native binary with no runtime dependencies, and a probe confirms the official CLI page exists. Missing for 10: detailed command reference or agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., JSON output, auth flow) in evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
